phone.title: Your mobile number
phone.sub: We'll send a 6-digit code by SMS. No password to remember.
phone.privacy: Your data is only yours. This number is used to log in and back up your data — nothing else.
phone.offlineBody: Internet is needed only for this first login. After that the app works fully without it. We'll try again as soon as you're back online.

otp.title: Enter the 6-digit code
otp.wrongOne: Wrong code. 1 try left — check the latest SMS.
otp.lockedBody: For your safety, try again in {{time}}. You can also ask for a new code then.
otp.offlineBody: Connect to the internet to check the code.
otp.autoReadAndroid: We read the SMS for you on Android
otp.autoReadIos: Tap the code shown above your keyboard

restore.title: Old data found
restore.sub: This number has a backup. Bring it back to this phone?
restore.size: About {{kb}} KB · takes under a minute on mobile data
restore.notMine: This isn't my business — use another number
restore.keepOpenBody: If the internet drops, we'll continue from where it stopped.
restore.failedSub: The internet dropped at {{pct}}%. Nothing is lost — continue from there.
restore.safeBody: It stays in the cloud until the restore finishes.
restore.freshBody: This phone will start empty. Your backup stays in the cloud and you can restore it later from More → Backup.

setup.title: About your business
setup.name: Business name
setup.errNameShort: Name must be at least 2 letters
setup.changeLater: You can change both later in More → Business profile.

retail.title: Shop / Retail
retail.effect: Quick selling; customer name is optional.

wholesale.title: Wholesale
wholesale.effect: Party name is shown on every buy and sell.

online.title: Online seller
online.effect: Marketplace fee and shipping fields open by default.

home.title: Home business
home.effect: Purchases track material costs for what you make.

qs.title: Three things to get going
qs.sub: Do them now or later — the list stays on Home.
qs.purchaseSub: So the app knows what things cost you
qs.starterSub: Tick what you stock — add 20 items in 2 minutes
qs.targetHelp: Used to suggest selling prices. You can set a different one per item.
qs.targetExample: Example: with {{pct}}, an item that costs you ₹100 is suggested at about ₹100 + {{pct}}.

home.comingSoon: Today's sales and profit will show here once you start selling.

placeholder.body: This screen is part of the next module. Items and stock are ready.

profile.title: Business profile
profile.name: Name
profile.modePriceEx: {{pct}} of the selling price is your profit.
profile.targetErr: Enter a sensible percentage (on selling price must be under 100%)

round.ex_nice: Rounds up to prices people expect: ₹9.50, ₹45, ₹149, ₹1,049.
round.ex_1: Rounds up to the next rupee.

profile.logoutNote: Logging out keeps your data on this phone. Changes not yet backed up are listed first.
profile.logoutBody: Your items and entries stay on this phone. You'll need an OTP to log in again.
profile.unbackedBody: They are safe on this phone, but not in the cloud yet. Back up when you are online to be fully safe.

items.emptyBody: Add what you sell: its name, unit and price. The app works out stock and profit for you.
items.noMatchBody: We also checked Hindi spellings. Check the spelling, or add it as a new item.
items.noMatchBodyHi: We also checked English spellings. Check the spelling, or add it as a new item.
items.archivedNote: Archived items keep their history. Open one to restore it.

item.name: Name
item.profitAt: Profit at this price {{amt}} / {{unit}} ▲ ({{pct}} on cost)
item.lossAt: Loss at this price {{amt}} / {{unit}} ▼ — price is below cost
item.addCostHint: Add cost below to see your profit
item.noCostWarn: Without cost, profit can't be worked out. Add it now, or it will come from your first purchase.
item.stockRule: Stock changes only through Buy, Sell and Adjust
item.stockRuleBody: Opening stock is what you had on day one.
item.openingWarnBody: Changing opening stock or cost updates stock and profit on every past sale of this item.
item.lowAlert: Alert me when stock is low
item.lowAlertHint: You'll get one reminder when stock drops to this.
item.photoDenied: Allow camera or photos in phone settings to add a picture.
item.discardBody: What you typed will not be saved.

detail.archivedBody: Hidden from lists and pickers. History is kept.
detail.lossBody: You're selling at {{price}}, cost is {{cost}}. That's a {{amt}} loss on every {{unit}}.
detail.negBody: More was sold than was bought. Usually a purchase wasn't recorded.
detail.noSuggestion: Record a purchase or add a cost to get a price suggestion.
detail.historyStub: A chart of cost and price over 90 days appears here after a few purchases.
detail.noActivity: No buying, selling or adjustments yet.
detail.archiveBody: It will be hidden from lists and pickers. All history is kept and you can restore it any time.
detail.archiveBlocked: Only items with zero stock can be archived. Stock now: {{qty}}. We can set it to 0 (recorded as an adjustment) and archive.

activity.deleteBody: Stock will be worked out again as if it never happened.

adjust.title: Adjust stock
adjust.moreThanStockBody: The app shows {{qty}}. Stock will go below zero — check the count.
adjust.summary: Stock will go from {{from}} → {{to}} on {{date}}. Average cost stays {{cost}}.

categories.title: Categories
categories.name: Category name
categories.footer: Only empty categories can be deleted. Move a category's items elsewhere first.
categories.errDuplicate: A category with this name already exists
categories.moveSub_one: It has {{count}} item. Pick where it should go.
categories.moveSub_other: It has {{count}} items. Pick where they should go.

starter.title: Common items
starter.sub: Tick what you stock. Prices and stock stay empty — your first purchase fills in cost.
starter.note: You can edit names and units later.

how.cost: Cost (higher of average and last purchase)
how.rounded: Rounded up to a nice price
how.note: The suggestion never goes below break-even. Change the target in More → Business profile.
